The Issue tracker should be used EXCLUSIVELY for reporting bugs. New features should be discussed on our Slack channel. Please use stackoverflow for support issues.

## Expected Behavior

Describe here what should happen.

## Current Behavior

Indicate here what is happening instead of the expected behavior.

## Possible Solution

Suggest a fix or the possible cause of the bug (optional).

## Steps to Reproduce

Provide a link to a live example, or a clear set of steps to reproduce this bug. Include relevant code if possible.

## Context (Environment)

Explain how this issue has affected you and what you are trying to accomplish. Providing context helps us come up with a more useful solution.

## Detailed Description

Provide a detailed description of the change or addition you are proposing.

## Possible Implementation

Suggest an idea for implementing the addition or change (optional).
